title: Compatible transitions for descended relative Proj degree-one twists
statement: Given a module L, chart isomorphisms, and normalized scalar-extension comparisons whose chart squares commute, for every affine U contained in V there is an additive transition on twist sections that intertwines chart reading with restriction and sends each homogeneous section a/1 to res(a)/1.

proof.text: Obtain the normalized scalar-extension comparison and commuting chart square from TwistChartCompatibility. Define the transition by the section-normalized pullback unit, the comparison isomorphism, and transport across the equality of chart preimages.
Apply the read-compatibility conjunct to obtain the equation intertwining twistChartRead with restriction.
Apply the homogeneous-fraction conjunct to obtain the equation on degree-one fractions.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_twist_chart_descent_transition
    (L : A.relProj.Modules)
    (chart : ∀ U : S.affineOpens,
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (A.relProjι U)).obj L ≅
        Proj.twist (A.grading U) 1)
    (hcompat : TwistChartCompatibility A L chart) :
    ∀ (U V : S.affineOpens) (h : U ≤ V),
      ∃ t : Γ(Proj.twist (A.grading V) 1, A.twistChartOpen V) →+
          Γ(Proj.twist (A.grading U) 1, A.twistChartOpen U),
        (∀ s : Γ(L, A.relProjHom ⁻¹ᵁ V.1),
          t (A.twistChartRead L chart V s) =
            A.twistChartRead L chart U
              (L.presheaf.map ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map A.relProjHom.base).map
                (homOfLE (X := S.Opens) h)).op s)) ∧
        (∀ a : A.grading V 1,
          t (A.twistChartFraction V a) =
            A.twistChartFraction U ⟨A.res h a, (A.res h).map_mem a.property⟩)
